mods.reason: Metroid Dread loads one mod that you pick in its launcher from a mods folder next to its work folder, and Graft can't manage that folder yet.

files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Metroid Dread.
files.detail: Play opens this app. It's named Metroid Dread.app, and MacNativeGames puts it next to your game file unless you chose another one when building. The app is small: it runs the game from the work folder, so keep that folder where it is.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game itself: the XCI or NSP file of the base game 1.0.0 you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: MacNativeGames builds the game app from it. Updates aren't supported for this game yet. Reading it needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's named Dread_build and sits next to your game file unless you chose another folder when building. The game app records where it is and runs the game from it.
